editorialRules: One physical artwork = one canonical object ID; three paintings in five-item Marguerittes cycle use distinct component discriminators despite same state register URL.
Subject visibility from source record is NOT user rating, art approval, complete narrative coverage, source JPEG photo, copyright clearance or app deployment.
Pictorially different events must remain distinct: Walking on Water (Peter sinks) not Calming Storm; Peter heals lame man Acts3 not Christ cures paralytic Mark2.
Sermon photograph absent means source identified only, NOT visual option ready for user review.
Do not silently launder historical workshop/copy paintings into autograph sources; maintain specified copy and attribution holds.
Preserve prior user zero-to-two exclusions and approved/ranked 277 scores; no updates to latest user export.
Existing paintings met/cma ids are reuse records; not new physical discoveries, not newly downloaded source masters.
Source owner photographs from French POP often all-rights-reserved, commercial reuse remains unresolved.
Do not treat Bible Atlas scene source records as a requirement for all 235 subject slots to each have unique paintings.
Current source-identity 222 research master count and eight verified JPEG acquisitions remain unchanged.
